arguments.instructions:
Discharge Instructions for Robert Kim:

MEDICATIONS:
- Lithium 900mg: Take twice daily (morning and evening)
- Olanzapine 15mg: Take once at bedtime
- Levothyroxine 75mcg: Take once daily in the morning
- Lorazepam 1mg: Take as needed for agitation (use only as directed)

IMPORTANT MONITORING:
- You must have lithium blood levels checked regularly as scheduled by your psychiatrist
- Watch for signs of lithium toxicity: tremors, confusion, nausea, increased thirst
- Stay well-hydrated and maintain consistent salt intake
- Report any medication side effects to your doctor immediately

FOLLOW-UP CARE:
- Schedule outpatient psychiatric appointment within 7 days of discharge
- Continue with your psychiatrist for ongoing medication management
- Contact crisis services if you experience worsening symptoms

Questions? Call your psychiatric provider or return to emergency department if needed.
